purpose: Compare a result with what its circumstances would lead one to expect.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain form + 割に; noun + の / な-adjective + な + 割に
It is well made considering how cheap it is.
She has a lot of stamina for her age.
I feel hungry considering how much I ate.
formation: Plain form + 割に; noun + の / な-adjective + な + 割に
restrictions: Often notes a surprising balance, such as good quality relative to low price.
mistake: Unlike に比べて, the comparison is with an expectation linked to a circumstance.
